variant: A: Tickets, assignees, and state transitions

domain_invariants.requirement: Project, membership, and ticket ids are immutable positive integers; every non-positive id is not found.
A project has a unique uppercase key matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$, name trimmed 3..120 characters, description trimmed 0..1000 characters, creator_account_id, and active boolean.

A membership references one active project and one account, is unique by project and account, and has active boolean. The project creator has an active membership that cannot be removed while the project exists.

A ticket references one active project, has title trimmed 3..160 characters, description trimmed 0..4000 characters, estimated_points integer 0..21, creator_account_id, optional assignee_membership_id, and status TODO, IN_PROGRESS, REVIEW, DONE, or CANCELLED.

A ticket assignee must be an active membership of the ticket project. An active membership with a TODO, IN_PROGRESS, or REVIEW assignment cannot be deactivated or removed until those tickets are reassigned or terminal.

Ticket status transitions are TODO to IN_PROGRESS or CANCELLED; IN_PROGRESS to REVIEW, DONE, or CANCELLED; REVIEW to IN_PROGRESS, DONE, or CANCELLED; DONE and CANCELLED are terminal. Every accepted transition stores the actor and supplied transition note trimmed 0..500 characters.

A user sees projects where the user has an active membership and tickets in those projects. A member may create tickets and edit or assign tickets that member created or is assigned; the project creator and a global admin may operate every project ticket. Private access denies by default.

A project may be soft-deleted only with no tickets and no non-creator memberships; deletion does not cascade. A ticket remains linked to its project through all allowed state transitions and cannot be deleted by this variant.
All lists are sorted by immutable ascending id, use limit 1..100 default 20, optional after_id greater than zero, and return a nullable next_after_id after filters are applied.
All writes are atomic. Validation, ownership, membership, assignment, transition, or uniqueness failures roll back every affected ticket, membership, and project relation.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all other routes require a valid non-expired local Bearer session.
Seed data contains two users, one admin, an active project with creator and member memberships, and tickets in TODO, IN_PROGRESS, REVIEW, DONE, and CANCELLED states.
JSON writes require application/json; malformed JSON is 400, wrong media type is 415, and valid JSON violating the declared contract is 422.
Only local persistence is used. A local outage returns 503 and an unexpected local failure returns 500 with no persistent changes.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization, probe local persistence without writing it, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-5-011; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence probe fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors have no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /projects to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional active boolean, key_prefix 1..10 uppercase characters, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-002 and REQ-5-009, restrict users to active memberships, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListProjects(request):
    // REQ-5-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ matching projects by id, constrained to active membership for user; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; state unchanged on success and error.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /projects to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON key, name, and optional description; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-002, atomically create the project and its creator membership, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /projects/{project_id} to an active project member or an admin, accepting a positive project_id; it shall enforce REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-007, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetProject(request, project_id):
    // REQ-5-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid, absent, or deleted project; REQUIRE membership or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; errors preserve relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /projects/{project_id} to its creator or an admin, accepting a positive project_id and JSON key, name, description, or active; it shall require application/json, validate the resulting REQ-5-002 project, atomically update supplied fields, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, preserve memberships and tickets, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /projects/{project_id} to its creator or an admin, accepting a positive project_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only a project satisfying REQ-5-008, be idempotent only insofar as an absent id is 404, never cascade to tickets or memberships, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /projects/{project_id}/memberships to an active project member or an admin, accepting a positive project_id, optional active boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-003, and REQ-5-009, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListMemberships(request, project_id):
    // REQ-5-017; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE membership or admin OR RETURN 401 or 403; RETURN 404 for absent project; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ memberships by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged on all outcomes.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /projects/{project_id}/memberships to its creator or an admin, accepting a positive project_id and JSON positive account_id; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-003, atomically add an active unique membership to an active project, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /projects/{project_id}/memberships/{membership_id} to its creator or an admin, accepting positive ids; it shall atomically deactivate a non-creator membership only when REQ-5-005 permits it, be non-idempotent, retain membership history and tickets, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tickets to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional positive project_id, positive assignee_membership_id, status, creator_account_id permitted only to admins, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-004, and REQ-5-009, restrict users to active-member projects, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListTickets(request):
    // REQ-5-020; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; REQUIRE admin for creator filter OR RETURN 403; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422; unknown project or membership is 404.
    READ tickets by id in user member projects or all admin rows; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /tickets to an active project member or an admin, accepting JSON positive project_id, title, optional description, and optional estimated_points default 0; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-004, atomically create a TODO ticket owned by the caller, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tickets/{ticket_id} to an active member of its project or an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id; it shall enforce REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-007, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTicket(request, ticket_id):
    // REQ-5-022; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent ticket; REQUIRE project membership or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: no ticket, state, or relation changes on error.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /tickets/{ticket_id} to its creator, assignee, project creator, or an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id and JSON title, description, or estimated_points; it shall require application/json, validate resulting REQ-5-004 data, atomically update only supplied fields without changing assignment or status, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/assignee to its creator, project creator, or an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id and JSON positive assignee_membership_id or null to unassign; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-005, atomically replace the assignee only with an active matching project membership, be idempotent for an identical valid target, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /tickets/{ticket_id}/transitions to its creator, assignee, project creator, or an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id and JSON target_status plus optional transition_note; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-004 and REQ-5-006, atomically record an allowed transition and actor, be non-idempotent, retain ticket history, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.
